description: Apply Solhint autofixes to one Solidity file. Previews by default; pass write: true to save. Prefer this over editing by hand after lint_file reports fixable findings.

filePath.description: Path to a .sol file, relative to the project root, e.g. 'contracts/Vault.sol'.

write.description: Write the fixed source back to the file. Defaults to false (preview only).

name: fix_file
